Bash(git -C /home/runner/workspace commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix empty project dropdown in log activity page

The organization query was fetching ALL organizations and blindly picking
the first one \(orgs[0]\), which was often not the user''s actual organization.
This caused all downstream queries \(projects, volunteers, external volunteers\)
to use the wrong organization ID, resulting in empty dropdowns.

Fix: derive organizationId from currentUser.organizationId \(the authenticated
user''s actual org link\) and use it for all data fetching. The organization
details query now properly finds the matching org from the list for display.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
